name: Anger And Forgiveness
overview: Scripture teaches that anger must be carefully controlled and not allowed to lead to sin, as believers are urged to cease from anger and avoid wrath (Psalms 37:8). Wisdom is shown in responding gently to anger, since harsh words provoke further conflict (Proverbs 15:1), and self-control over one's spirit is more commendable than conquering a city (Proverbs 16:32). Unchecked anger results in strife and transgression (Proverbs 29:22), but those who wait on the Lord are renewed in strength to endure and overcome (Isaiah 40:31). Forgiveness and reconciliation are vital, as believers are instructed to confront a brother who sins privately to restore fellowship (Matthew 18:15).
